messages:
Alex: FYI noticed org-wide group "OrgAdmin" got a large membership bump from the HR sync overnight (~12 users). Posting here to coordinate safe rollback and evidence capture.
Priya: Ugh. Which users? Any contractors?
Alex: Quick list exported to the ticket: bob.m, carl.s, contractor-17, integrator-bot, hr-sync-batch, junior-ops. 3 are contractors, 2 service principals.
Sam: Preliminary audit: found AttachGroupPolicy events at ~02:12 UTC across three accounts. Query I used: `gcloud logging read 'protoPayload.methodName="SetIamPolicy" AND resource.labels.group="OrgAdmin"' --limit 50`
Jordan: Also saw two KMS grants to the service principals referencing prod-key-v2 (kms:Decrypt). If we remove group membership, those grants might orphan or break CI/key use.
Ops: I'm going to create a temporary IAM conditional that denies OrgAdmin actions outside the admin console for 1h so we can run dependency checks without full outage. Applying now and will annotate the incident.
sec-bot: automated notice — quarterly-access-review scheduled in 72h. Please attach compliance evidence within 5 days.
Priya: For compliance, we need: 1) auth events for the last 7d 2) list of resources touched while in-group 3) owner attestations for each principal we plan to remove. Can someone assemble?
Alex: I can open ticket SEC-5921 and attach the raw events. Priya — can you coordinate owner attestations? Sam — logs?
Sam: On it. Running a scoped dry-run to identify dependent principals:
- enumerate KMS Grants: `aws kms list-grants --key-id prod-key-v2`
- service-account tokens: `gcloud iam service-accounts keys list --iam-account=...`
- CI job scans (grep for OrgAdmin in repos)
I'll drop a short report in ~30m.
Jordan: Rollback plan (safe): add a holdlist with owners for 24h exceptions, then remove non-exempt users in batches of 4, wait 10m between batches and monitor error rate > 0.5% triggers immediate rollback. Script TBC.
Ops: People-ops asked to pause the HR group sync. @people-ops please confirm hold on automated provisioning for OrgAdmin until we close SEC-5921.
people-ops: Confirmed — HR sync paused for OrgAdmin group only. We'll resume after sign-off.
Priya: Also raised with compliance: we need preservation of original policy blobs and the diff of membership for the audit trail. Sam — can you capture snapshots?
Sam: Yep — taking snapshots now: exporting IAM policy, group membership CSV, and cloud audit log slice. Uploading to SEC-5921.
Alex: Note: don't remove integrator-bot yet — it's used for cross-account reporting. Jordan please validate with the app owner.
Jordan: Confirmed integrator-bot owner is analytics-team@. Marked as exception pending owner attestation.
Ops: Applying deny lift in 1h if no regressions, else extend. Monitoring alerts flagged.
Alex: Thanks. After evidence is captured we'll run removal in the morning window and keep a 24h rollback. Please flag any business-critical exceptions live here.
Priya: One more ask — include a concise one-page summary for auditors describing rationale and controls we used during the cleanup. I'll draft and post for review.
Sam: Report posted to SEC-5921: `s3://sec-evidence/SEC-5921/{events,policies,membership}.zip`.
Alex: Great work team. We'll reconvene if any errors surface. :white_check_mark:
